name: Descending triangle
shape: Falling highs against a level floor.
description: Each rally stopping lower while the same floor is tested again and again. Read downward, so the stages here are named for a breakdown and the level shown is the floor. It is a separate screen from the other two triangles for exactly that reason: mixing directions in one screen would make its stage counts the sum of two different things. This shape has never been tested on this site. The out-of-sample study behind the base screens found no measurable edge in their structural parts — only in relative strength — and no equivalent study has been run against trendline shapes at all. Read this screen as a description of what the chart is doing, which is checkable, and not as a reason to expect anything.

concepts.title: The floor
concepts.text: A level the lows keep returning to.

concepts.title: Lower highs
concepts.text: Each rally stopping short of the last.

funnel.title: The liquid US universe
funnel.text: US common stocks over $5, market cap over $300M, and at least $5M traded a day over the last 20 sessions.

funnel.title: Where we fit the lines
funnel.text: The two trendlines are fitted over the last 12 weeks.

funnel.title: Long enough to be a formation
funnel.text: The formation has lasted at least 2 weeks.

funnel.title: The lines are closing
funnel.text: The gap between the lines ends at 0.7 of what it started at.

funnel.title: Leadership
funnel.text: Relative strength rating of 70 or better.

funnel_preface: Every number below is a dial you can move in Filters.

params.label: How far back to fit the trendlines
params.funnel_text: The two trendlines are fitted over the last {value} weeks.
params.help: The window the swing highs and swing lows are taken from. Longer finds bigger, older structures; shorter finds tighter, newer ones.

params.label: Shortest formation we'll accept
params.funnel_title: Long enough to be a formation
params.funnel_text: The formation has lasted at least {value} weeks.
params.help: Two lines can be fitted through almost any handful of bars. This is the span below which doing so is arithmetic rather than structure.

params.label: How much the lines must close
params.funnel_text: The gap between the lines ends at {value} of what it started at.
params.help: The distance between the two trendlines at the end of the window divided by the distance at the start. 1.0 is parallel — a channel, not a wedge. Lower numbers demand a tighter squeeze.

params.label: Smallest swing that counts as a contraction
params.help: A move smaller than this is treated as noise rather than as a pullback, so the contraction list stays readable.

params.label: Lowest RS rating we'll accept
params.funnel_text: Relative strength rating of {value} or better.
params.help: Where the stock's 3, 6 and 12-month return ranks against every other name in the universe, 1 to 99. This is the one filter with published statistical support behind it.

params.label: How recent counts as fresh
params.help: A breakout stays in the fresh bucket for this many sessions before it moves to climbing.

trade_steps.title: Buy the breakout
trade_steps.text: As it pushes through the pivot.

trade_steps.title: Set a safety net
trade_steps.text: An automatic exit if it drops about 8% from where you got in.

trade_steps.title: Lock in "no loss"
trade_steps.text: Once it is up enough, move that net to where you started.

trade_steps.title: Ride the trend
trade_steps.text: Raise the net as it climbs.

trade_steps_preface: Risk is decided before entry — about 1.5% of capital on any one trade.
